summary: 15-year-old boy on a group camping trip to the North Inlet group site (~9,290 ft, ~6.5 mi from the trailhead) became ill the previous night and was not improving; a nearby backcountry ranger plus three others treated him; he was ridden out on horseback to the trailhead ~midnight and ambulanced to Granby Medical Clinic
location: North Inlet group site, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Incident date pinned to Sun 2011-07-24: report filed Wed Jul 27 says rangers learned of the illness "on Sunday afternoon"; weekday-verified.
